# topath.py

[简体中文](topath.zh.md) ｜ **English** ｜ [← Back to README](../../README.en.md)

`convert_to_path()` turns geometry elements into an equivalent `PathElement`;

This module backs `Element.to_path_element()`: `convert_to_path()` turns geometry
elements (rect / circle / ellipse / line / polygon / polyline) into an equivalent
`PathElement` while keeping the original; a `PathElement` is returned as is.
Kinds that need outline extraction (images, text) raise `NotImplementedError`
with the `err.to_path_todo` message instead of silently failing. Fill / stroke
styles carry over to the new path and keyword arguments override them.

### Functions

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `convert_to_path` | Convert a geometry element into an equivalent PathElement (the original stays). |

## Full example

Run it directly in PyCharm, or from the command line: `python malight/elements/topath.py`

```python
if __name__ == "__main__":
    import os

    from malight import Malight, ColorName

    _out = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__),
                                        "..", "..", "output"))
    pen = Malight(os.path.join(_out, "demo_topath"), width=420, height=300)
    pen.set_background_color(ColorName.WHITESMOKE)

    rect = pen.rect(40, 40, 120, 80, fill_color=ColorName.TEAL,
                    stroke_color="gray")
    rp = rect.to_path_element()
    print("rect ->", type(rp).__name__, "| d:", rp.get_d())   # rounded

    circle = pen.circle(240, 80, 40, fill_color="none",
                        stroke_color=ColorName.CRIMSON, stroke_width=3)
    cp = circle.to_path_element()
    print("circle -> d:", cp.get_d()[:60], "...")

    poly = pen.polygon([(60, 180), (150, 180), (105, 260)],
                       fill_color=ColorName.GOLD)
    pp = poly.to_path_element()
    print("polygon -> d:", pp.get_d())

    try:
        pen.text(240, 220, "hi").to_path_element()
    except NotImplementedError as exc:
        print("expected）:", exc)

    pen.finish()
```
